date_note: Date is SMBC's announcement of 20 November; the intrusion into PLAID's KARTE was reported to SMBC on 13 November.
title: SMBC says up to about 14 million customer records leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
summary: Cybersecurity.com and Rocket Boys report that SMBC announced on 20 November a leak of customer information, up to about 14 million records, after unauthorized access to KARTE at its contractor PLAID. The reports say the data includes date of birth and category values; name, address, phone, email, account number and internet-banking login are not included. No impact on assets or transactions is confirmed so far.
plain: Sumitomo Mitsui Bank says up to about 14 million customer records leaked through its contractor PLAID's KARTE service. Names, account numbers and logins are reported not included.
exec: Up to about 14 million bank customer records exposed through a vendor's marketing tool.
action: SMBC customers: watch for phishing that uses your date of birth and follow SMBC's own notices.

sources.name: Rocket Boys Security Measures Lab (Japan), 21 Nov 2026

validation.note: Cybersecurity.com and Rocket Boys Security Measures Lab each report SMBC's 20 Nov announcement of up to about 14 million records (a record count, not a count of customers), the excluded data types and no confirmed asset impact. SMBC's own PDF was not read.
